integrity: Finite numerical checks concern only the explicit example. The general theorem is proved analytically. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies extreme points and proves a necessary curvature condition for area minimizers; it does not compute the global minimum or identify all minimizers. Possible earlier coverage in Zhang (DOI 10.1007/s13366-015-0252-8) remains unresolved because full text was inaccessible.
title: Extreme-point rigidity under constant higher-order width
